If your systems are GitHub (repo) and AWS IAM (group), run either of the GitHub commands below depending on how Marcus was granted repo write access, then the AWS command.

GitHub — remove direct collaborator:
gh api -X DELETE /repos/acme/billing-service/collaborators/marcus

GitHub — remove via org/team membership (use if the team grants repo access):
gh api -X DELETE /orgs/acme/teams/prod-deployers/memberships/marcus

AWS IAM — remove from prod-deployers group:
aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name prod-deployers --user-name marcus

One-line audit note for the ticket:
"2026-09-03: Removed user 'marcus' write access to acme/billing-service and removed him from IAM group 'prod-deployers' per Legal-cleared offboarding." 

If you use a different VCS/cloud provider, tell me which and I’ll give the exact commands for that platform.
